legal.headline: Retro Application of Interim Moratorium Amendment: Legislature Avenging to Go Back in Time
legal.contextNote: The article discusses the Supreme Court’s decision to apply retroactively an amendment to the interim moratorium under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (IBC). The amendment, introduced by the Insolvency and Bankruptcy (Amendment) Act, 2023, altered the duration of the moratorium period and the conditions for its extension. The Court held that the amendment could be applied to cases pending before the amendment’s commencement date, effectively allowing parties to benefit from the extended moratorium even if their proceedings began earlier.
